checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three scenes in order: Earth, Jupiter, Saturn
must.why: One continuous scene of the probe and Golden Record pulling back from the Sun. No Earth, Jupiter or Saturn scenes.

must.item: Probe has Voyager dish and booms
must.why: White dish, boom and gold record are visible. The detail is fairly good.

must.item: No Uranus/Neptune claims or conflicting dates
must.why: There is no text and no such planets.
Audio cannot be checked from frames. The user asked for no sound, so it is probably silent.

faults.what: The 'fact' video has no on-screen facts or captions. It is only a pullback shot of the probe.
The Earth, Jupiter and Saturn scenes are missing, so the planned structure is not there.
The Sun looks like a bright star with a lens flare, and the probe is tiny at the end.
The gold record is mounted on the side of the bus, and the probe's geometry is a little off.

summary: The clip is a good-looking Voyager pullback shot, but it has no text and no Earth, Jupiter or Saturn scenes, so it misses the fact-video brief.
